title: All chips: every benchmark chip across the collections
description: Every chip of every Fields of the World benchmark collection in one table, one row per collection and chip, with one column per split scheme: split_hash_v1 and split_admin2_v1 give a location the same split in every collection, so collections can be pooled without a location on both sides. The tiles map every chip location by its admin2 split. Each row carries its collection's license.

links.title: Each row carries its own collection's license (README, License)
Source: the benchmark collections the table is built from
Chip locations as vector tiles, with their splits

chips.title: Chips of every collection, with one column per split scheme
chips.description: One row per chip of every published collection, with its splits under each scheme, its admin units and its collection's license.

table:columns.name: dataset
table:columns.description: The collection the chip is in (its id, such as at_2024).

table:columns.name: group
table:columns.description: The source group the collection is published under: the harmonized source collection it was cut from.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: The chip's cell id on the FTW grid: the same id is the same square of ground in every collection.

table:columns.name: block
table:columns.description: The chip's 3x3 block of grid cells, the unit split_hash_v1 is drawn for.

table:columns.name: admin0_iso3
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the chip's country (FAO GAUL 2024).

table:columns.name: admin1_name
table:columns.description: The chip's first-level administrative unit (FAO GAUL 2024).

table:columns.name: admin2_name
table:columns.description: The chip's second-level administrative unit (FAO GAUL 2024).

table:columns.name: license
table:columns.description: The collection's license, an SPDX id or other.

table:columns.name: license_url
table:columns.description: The collection's own license link (the SPDX page for a standard id).

table:columns.name: license_category
table:columns.description: The license sorted for filtering: public-domain, attribution and share-alike allow any use, including commercial; then non-commercial, restricted, and unknown where the terms aren't judged yet.

table:columns.name: presence_only
table:columns.description: The collection's ftw:presence_only: its labels mark fields that exist, not where fields are absent.

table:columns.name: split_legacy
table:columns.description: What the collection published before this table (a seeded block3x3 or predefined split). Frozen, so chips added later are null.

table:columns.name: split_predefined
table:columns.description: The source's own split, for collections whose source defines one.

table:columns.name: split_hash_v1
table:columns.description: train, val or test from a stable hash of the chip's block, 80/10/10: a location has the same split in every collection and year.

table:columns.name: unit_admin2_v1
table:columns.description: The unit split_admin2_v1 assigns: the chip's admin2 area (its admin1 when it has no admin2 name, or its block where a country has too few admin2 areas to balance).

table:columns.name: split_admin2_v1
table:columns.description: train, val or test for whole admin2 units, balanced to 80/10/10 within each country. A unit with a presence-only chip is train.

chips_tiles.title: Chip locations as vector tiles, with their splits
chips_tiles.description: Every chip location at every zoom: one polygon per location from zoom 7, each split's chip centres clustered below it.

style-split-admin2.title: Chips by admin2 split
style-split-admin2.description: MapLibre style: chip locations coloured by split_admin2_v1, train green, val orange, test purple.

thumbnail.title: Chip locations of every collection, by admin2 split
thumbnail.description: Preview image of the collection rendered with its default map style.
